limitations: Actual Hancom GUI/layout comparison is deferred.
No paid LLM request: Agent tests use a deterministic local adapter.
Full Hangul feature parity remains incomplete; no percentage of completion is inferred from these scoped tests.
Unsupported source properties may be blocked by the stricter cell preservation guard.

Creation creates one missing stored plain header/footer with up to 4000 Unicode characters and current default shape zero. Empty text creates a blank override; inherited content may be overridden but hiding/other parity definitions remain. Complex documents, initial custom font/paragraph settings, batch/repeat/automatic save are unsupported.

Deletion removes one existing native-guarded plain stored header/footer only in plain body documents with root section/column/header/footer controls. Tables/objects/fields/other controls, unknown/complex/mixed/multiple sources, creation, batch and repeat are unsupported. Deletion can reveal inherited content and is not global hiding.

Stored plain header/footer paragraph command supports five alignments and integer 50..500 Percent spacing only. Alignment alone retains current mode. Margins/indent/tabs/borders/numbering, complex sources, creation/deletion, batching and repeat remain unsupported.

Existing plain nonempty stored header/footer whole-paragraph font formatting supports bold/italic/underline/1..200pt/RGB only. Original native source/token and current-format save protections remain; this character command excludes family/spacing/paragraph changes, mixed/empty/multiple sources and batching/repeat. A separate scoped paragraph command may be available.

The header/footer text command replaces an existing native-guarded single plain paragraph only. Dynamic fields, objects, multiple/mixed/long definitions, inheritance overrides, creation and repeat recording are unsupported here; a separately guarded delete command may be available. Private tokens never reach the model.

Agent merging is isolated on two plain single-column editable sources only; masters/numbering/tables/objects/fields/page-hide/mixed originals and 4000+ joined paragraph are refused. Right settings follow preceding settings; no arbitrary nonempty section deletion or repeat recording.

Empty body section removal is a standalone command only for a native-supported whole plain document; sole/nonempty/whitespace/complex originals are refused. Removing a section removes its paper/background too; no arbitrary merge outside its separate guarded command, private model token, repeat recording or automatic save.

Agent splitting is a standalone source-section command for one-column editable plain body only; table/field/page-hide/numbered/mixed sources, structural batching and repeat recording are refused. Source inheritance follows the guarded native splitter.
Section repeats require explicit current destinations and revalidate source capabilities; existing table/object/style ID and script recording remain unsupported.

Agent masters support stored basic uniform text only, not pictures/tables/fields/extensions. HWP sparse parity combinations and long originals are refused; deleting a stored master does not suppress earlier inheritance.
Agent background commands support none/plain solid originals only. Image, gradient, hatch, alpha, mixed/advanced effects are read-only; parity geometry and original visibility are preserved.
Agent tools support section default tabs and bounded HWPX line numbering; per-paragraph tabs, binary HWP numbering, external MCP and automatic save remain unsupported.
Native HWPX file caret supports bounded single-section plain body only; multiple sections, nested stories, tabs/fields/objects and native Hancom verification remain deferred.
